WATCH: The View Debates Pete Hegseth Impeachment Articles [Video] Tuesday's episode of  The View kicked off with a "Hot Topic" indeed: the latest moves to oust Secretary of War Pete Hegseth from his role. Rep. Thomas Massie reintroduced articles of impeachment against Hegseth. Moderator Whoopi Goldberg recapped incidents that had happened under Hegseth's watch, including the military bombing boats in the Caribbean after alleging they were carrying drugs and the scandal "Signalgate." She then addressed Hegseth, stating: Time for you to go, man. Yeah. Time for... I'm sorry. It's time for you. Joy Behar weighed in and said Hegseth is throwing President Donald Trump "under the bus" in a subtle fashion. She mused: Number one, he called the Iran war a historic event effort only made possible by a courageous commander-in-chief. He claimed Americans are lining up to serve President Trump's Department of War. So he says he's just following orders. Behar added that Hegseth "has them by the short hairs now." Sara Haines chimed in: I do think he was specific in the language blaming it on President Trump. But I've never felt
he was the brain behind the closed doors that was leading this. Behar replied: Why are they going after him? Impeach the commander-in-chief!
